description: User approved architecture correction on 2026-10-04. Extend existing Bridge.to_internal contract; Channels emits validated conversation type (one_to_one, room, recipient_addressed), source namespace, timestamps and message-local audience, never history_kind/title policy/capture decisions. Engine derives existing Direct/Shared/Replicated policies and owns ingress capture including nonmentions. Remove history-specific config and use existing bridge/provider integration for normalization and neutral room-member/message queries. Preserve previous uncommitted remediation, IDs/cursors/account encoding. Steps tracked as child issues. Action reuse: extend bridge and existing Engine ingress/domain APIs, local-only transport normalization, reuse membership Action, no new tool/Action exposure. Tests first: provider-independent Engine selection, contradictory/unknown facts, no strategy hints accepted from transport; real chat/email capture, recipient isolation, scoped reaction namespace, membership/root fallback regressions. Docs Channels/Engine authoritative contracts. Validation focused suites, mix q, existing E2E and final precommit; coverage handoff remains separate after review. No commit/push authorization.

comments.text: Neutral-boundary implementation is now in the uncommitted working tree. Replaces the former HistoryEvidence/HistoryProvider plan rather than completing it: existing Bridge.to_internal emits conversation_type, provider-local integrations normalize once on listener ingress and own Discord enrichment; no history-specific config. Engine CommunicationPolicy owns kind/title derivation, receives nonmentions through receive_incoming_message and interprets delivery confirmations through History.Delivery. Bridge room_capabilities/room_members/fetch_room_message are consumer-neutral. Receipts use audience/source_scope/conversation_id; Channels preserves send success with confirmation_recording unavailable if Engine transport fails. Canonical IDs, account encoding, cursor and prior remediation preserved. mix q passed; affected regression run passed 1536 tests and 26 properties. Issue-scoped commit/landing remains blocked by no commit authorization; do not close dependent issues or treat this as final approval. Existing E2E and final precommit remain to rerun.

title: Centralize history decisions in Engine and normalize communication facts in Channels
